items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Jimmy Durante was, he did twelve weeks with us. ... Jimmy Durante was part of the act

ctx.x: What about the war years? Did you go in the service?

Well the day after we opened at the Blue Gardens with Red, that was December 6, 1941. So the war started the next day. But we did travel, we traveled in the midwest, did a lot of theaters. And Jimmy Durante was, he did twelve weeks with us. But at that point you couldn’t get gas so we had to travel by train. We had our own car — I mean car on the train, you know what I mean?
Sure. A Pullman type? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-
